callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing project directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance backed by the project's CodeGraph index when the index exists and is readable; returns None when the index is absent or could not be loaded.

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_function_spans
callees.signature: get_function_spans(language: str, filepath: str) -> list | None
callees.pre_condition: language is a string identifying a registered language key (e.g. "javascript"); filepath is a string path to a source file of that language; the receiver is a valid CodeGraphExtractor instance.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples for each function in the file when the file is indexed by CodeGraph, where start_idx and end_idx are 0-indexed inclusive line positions; returns None when the file is not indexed by CodeGraph.
